reviews.title: Didn’t work after I bought subscription
reviews.text: Got this coloring game for my daughter a year ago. Buy you know how the story goes if you don’t cancel you get a whole year membership. Following the trial the money was taken out for the year membership. That’s fine but there’s thing is everyone my daughter opened the app it would never pass the loading screen. Noticed this on several occasions but never took action. Anyways spent the full 50 for the year because I forgot to cancel membership and it didn’t work. Don’t download this app. Couldn’t get a refund or an option for one.

reviews.title: POTENTIAL FRAUD
reviews.text: Be careful in downloading TODLI, it appears the app subscribed us to one of their other apps for annual subscription for £29.99, called “Drawing for girls princess games”. Odd that the subscribed dodgy app appeared to be titled in Russian, and not even installed on the device! I have just reported the developer and the app for a code audit and backend / server activity! please everyone double check your banks for purchases by this app!

reviews.title: Not helpful for drawing
reviews.text: This app is basically a app for little kids it doesn’t actually help you draw, I mean they do have step by step drawings but I could draw it even without the step by step directions. I think this app has more coloring things than drawing. If you have like younger children like 7 or under then they might like this app, but if you like actually want to learn how to draw this isn’t the app that I recommend.
